en: Color postcard showing a socialist‑era high‑rise with stacked balconies and a low commercial podium in front. Signs on the podium read RESTAURANT and MAGAZIN UNIVERSAL. People gather near the entrances and a small car is parked by the building; conifer trees frame the scene. The reverse side is printed in Romanian with address fields, price, publisher and photographer credit, and the city name.
